hints.title: Direct Prime Feasibility
hints.text: If the target integer is prime itself, exactly one prime is required.

hints.title: Even Target Decomposition
hints.text: According to number theory, every even integer greater than two can be expressed as the sum of two primes.

hints.title: Odd Target Parity Analysis
hints.text: For odd numbers, test if subtracting two yields a prime; if so, two primes suffice, otherwise three primes are needed.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Trial division tests for target and target minus two.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General knapsack DP up to target explores unnecessary combinations when number theoretic bounds guarantee at most 3 primes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct primality testing uses constant auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply Goldbach conjecture logic to bound answer by at most 3.
